label: Import labels
purpose: Bring in a label image segmented outside Cecelia
useWhen: Labels made in another tool (OME-Zarr or TIFF) for this image
A segmentation run elsewhere on a larger machine
notWhen: You want measures too: use Import labels + measure
Old Cecelia (R) projects: use Migrate legacy image

params.label: Image
params.tip: Image version the labels were made on; its shape must match

params.label: Output name
params.tip: Name for the imported label set

params.label: Cell labels
params.requiredMessage: Pick the label image to import
params.placeholder: Browse for an OME-Zarr or TIFF
params.tip: One id per cell, same shape as the image without channels

params.label: Nucleus labels
params.tip: Optional; measured as nuc_* columns of each cell

params.label: Match nucleus ids
params.tip: Give each nucleus the id of the cell it overlaps; off if ids already pair

params.label: Match threshold
params.tip: Overlap (IoU) a nucleus needs with its cell
